parameters.content:
## CONNECTWISE AUTO-ASSIGNMENT ENGINE

Purpose:
Automatically evaluates ConnectWise tickets and assigns them to the most suitable engineer based on rules, skill level, shift coverage, availability, workload, exclusions, and escalation requirements.

**Created By: Workflow Author**
Platform: n8n + ConnectWise Manage
Automation: Ticket Auto-Assignment
Architecture: Rule-Based + Availability + Workload + Escalation

## TICKET INTAKE

Schedule Trigger

Starts the automated ticket-assignment cycle according to the configured schedule.

Get row(s) in sheet

Loads the master configuration required for the assignment workflow.

CFG-001

Validates and prepares workflow configuration and runtime parameters.

CW-001 – Get Incident Tickets

Retrieves eligible incident tickets from ConnectWise for processing.

CODE-000A – Save Tickets

Normalizes and prepares retrieved ticket data for downstream processing.

## RULES & MASTER DATA

GS-001 – Read Exclusion Rules

Loads rules identifying tickets or conditions that must not be auto-assigned.

CODE-000B – Save Exclusions

Processes and prepares exclusion rules for assignment evaluation.

GS-002 – Read ShiftMaster

Loads engineer shift schedules and coverage definitions.

CODE-000C – Save Shifts

Normalizes shift information for coverage and availability calculations.

GS-003 – Read EngineerMaster

Loads engineer profiles, levels, skills, and assignment attributes.

CODE-000D – Save Engineers

Processes and prepares engineer master data for selection.

##  WEEKLY ROSTER

GS-006 – Read OriginalRoster

Loads the original engineer roster used as the baseline for weekly scheduling.

ROSTER-001 – Build WeeklyRoster

Builds the weekly engineer roster using shift and roster rules.

GS-007A – Clear WeeklyRoster

Removes the previous roster before generating the new weekly roster.

CODE-007 – Prepare WeeklyRoster Rows

Formats calculated roster records for storage in the weekly roster.

GS-007 – Write WeeklyRoster

Writes the newly generated weekly roster to the roster sheet.

GS-004 – Read WeeklyRoster

Loads the finalized weekly roster for assignment processing.

##  SUPPORT CALENDAR & CONTEXT

GS-005 – Read SupportCalendar

Loads holidays, support exceptions, special coverage, and calendar information.

CODE-000E – Save SupportCalendar

Normalizes support-calendar data for assignment calculations.

CODE-001 – Build Context

Combines ticket, roster, shift, calendar, engineer, and rule data into the common processing context.

##  LIVE AVAILABILITY
CW-003 – Get InOut Board

Retrieves current engineer In/Out status from ConnectWise.

CODE-003 – Live Availability

Converts ConnectWise In/Out data into usable engineer availability status.

CW-002 – Get InOut Board

Retrieves current ConnectWise engineer availability for assignment evaluation.

CODE-002 – Assignment Engine

Evaluates available engineers against assignment rules and eligibility criteria.

MERGE-001 – Planned + Live

Combines planned roster availability with real-time engineer availability.

CODE-004 – Build Live Eligibility

Builds the final list of engineers currently eligible for ticket assignment.

##  WORKLOAD ENGINE

CW-002 – Get Workload Tickets

Retrieves open/assigned tickets used to calculate current engineer workload.

CW-TEST – Get All Ticket Schedules

Retrieves ticket schedule information required for workload analysis.

Merge

Combines ticket workload data with ticket schedule information.

Calculate Workload

Calculates engineer workload to support balanced and fair ticket distribution.

Merge1

Combines workload results with the main assignment decision data.

##  ESCALATION & SELECTION
CODE-005 – Escalation Engine

Determines whether the ticket should be assigned normally, escalated, or left unassigned.

GS-008 – Read Assignment State

Loads previous assignment state to maintain continuity and prevent conflicting assignments.

CODE-006 – Engineer Selection

Selects the best eligible engineer based on level, availability, workload, shift, and assignment rules.

Merge2

Combines engineer-selection results with the final assignment context.

CODE-007 – Build Assignment

Creates the final assignment payload required by ConnectWise.

##  CONNECTWISE ASSIGNMENT
CW-006A – Get Selected Member

Retrieves the ConnectWise member record for the selected engineer.

CW-004 – Assign Ticket Resource

Assigns the selected engineer/resource to the ConnectWise ticket.

CW-005 – Update Ticket Resource

Updates the ConnectWise ticket with the finalized resource assignment.

CW-006B – Get Ticket Detail

Retrieves the ticket after assignment to verify the resulting ticket state.

CW-007 – Get Engineer Member

Retrieves engineer/member details required for final assignment-state tracking.

CODE-010 – Prepare Assignment State

Prepares the final assignment result, status, engineer, and decision information for logging.

ConnectWise_AutoAssignment_State

Stores the final assignment state for tracking, audit, and future assignment decisions.

##  OVERALL DECISION LOGIC

TICKET ASSIGNMENT DECISION FLOW

Collect Tickets
Apply Exclusion Rules
Load Engineer & Shift Data
Build Weekly Roster
Check Support Calendar
Check Live Availability
Calculate Workload
Build Engineer Eligibility
Evaluate Escalation
Select Engineer
Assign Ticket
Verify Assignment
Save Assignment State

## BUSINESS RULES

AUTO-ASSIGNMENT PRINCIPLES

Assign only eligible tickets.
Respect exclusion rules.
Respect engineer skill/level requirements.
Respect shift and support coverage.
Consider real-time availability.
Consider current workload.
Apply escalation rules when required.
Avoid invalid or duplicate assignments.
Record every final assignment decision.
Leave the ticket unassigned when no valid engineer is available.
